title: Changing dates
body:
I love the app but…

Whenever i write an event that already occured and it auto fills in, it changes the hour to the previous event. My ux looks like this: i have a weekly appointment but the day in the week and the hour each time changes as we plan it. So I write in the hour (ex. 17:00) and name it Appointment and it auto fills the name. But the hour that I’ve already wrote in, changes back to the last week’s. It’s annoying and i have to change it twice. I’ve missed an appointment coz of this
